Values marked ** in the chart require additional lifting equipment: all 360° values at 10-18 ft for 43.3/57.1/70.9 ft booms (e.g. 385.6 kips = 174.9 t @10 ft) and 84.6 ft at 10-12 ft. chartIncludesHookBlock=true is NOT stated in this document (no capacity remarks page); set per Tadano's standard remark (hook blocks and slings are part of the load) found in the ATF 100G-4 SAE datasheet - verify. Dimensions p.2 (mm): overall length 15921 (boom head to superstructure rear; 15121 and 13229 also shown), boom tip to carrier rear 15050 (1605 boom overhang + 13445 carrier); axle spacing 2546 (front to axle 1), 2700, 1650, 2440, 1700; rear overhang 2409. Slewing centre: the front/rear outrigger chain 5510 + 3500 and the upper chains (4949/4180/2600) start from a vertical line that coincides with axle 4 in the drawing - no separate offset is dimensioned, so slewCentreFromFront_m = axle 4 position is a drawing-based approximation. Outriggers: text p.29 gives 27'-2.75'' (8.3 m) x 29'-6.75'' (9.01 m); drawing shows 5677.5 + 3297 and 5342.5 + 3703 = 9045.5 longitudinal and 8300 transverse (3600 intermediate / 5.6 m mid). Height 3939; width 3000 (445/95R25) / 3200 (525/80R25). Tail radius R4980 (R4217 also shown). 7-section boom 13.2-68.0 m (p.29). Counterweight 71.0 t total (p.29). Axle loads 5 x 26,455 lbs = 132,275 lbs (60 t) in road configuration; operating weight with full counterweight not stated.
